overview_description.description:
Rehla is an application based in Saudi Arabia that aims to simplify the struggles of travelers traveling from one city to another. Pioneered as a ridesharing concept, we have established ourselves in the market by introducing a plethora of services like Airport pick-up and drop, Tour trips with verified tour guides, and one-day package delivery. It is now upon our potential travelers to choose their ride as ride-hailing or ridesharing.
Passengers can also find us at 23 airports in Saudi Arabia and 3 Haramain railway station which includes: Jeddah, Makkah, and Medina.
